# omada_port_forwarding (Resource)

Manages an Omada gateway port-forwarding rule. The resource deliberately excludes DMZ because DMZ exposes every port; use explicit port/range mappings instead. Targets the Open API v1 NAT surface (`/openapi/v1/.../nat/port-forwardings`) on controller firmware such as 6.2.x. Import with `<site_id>/<port_forwarding_id>`. Requires one of: `Site Settings Manager Modify` or `Network Config Page Modify`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# WireGuard UDP port forwarding. Keep the internal endpoint on a stable address
# (for example, an Omada DHCP reservation) and select the intended WAN port
# explicitly. CGNAT links cannot accept unsolicited inbound traffic.
resource "omada_port_forwarding" "wireguard" {
  site_id       = "<site-id>"
  name          = "WireGuard"
  status        = true
  external_port = "51820"
  forward_ip    = "192.168.1.5"
  forward_port  = "51820"
  protocol      = 2 # UDP

  wan_port_ids = ["<primary-wan-port-id>"]

  # Empty means any external source. Populate this only when peers originate
  # from stable public addresses.
  source_addresses = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_port` (String) WAN/source port or inclusive range, e.g. `51820` or `8000-8010`.
- `forward_ip` (String) Destination IPv4 address on the LAN.
- `forward_port` (String) Destination port or inclusive range, e.g. `51820` or `9000-9010`.
- `name` (String) Rule name, 1 to 64 characters and unique within the site.
- `protocol` (Number) Transport protocol: `0` = TCP+UDP, `1` = TCP, `2` = UDP.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID the rule belongs to. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `source_addresses` (List of String) Optional external source-address allowlist. An empty list allows any source; a non-empty list makes Omada use its limited-address mode.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `virtual_wan_ids` (List of String) Optional virtual-WAN IDs on which to accept the mapping.
- `wan_ips` (Map of String) Optional WAN-address selector as a map of WAN port ID to WAN IP.
- `wan_port_ids` (List of String) Physical WAN port IDs to accept the mapping on. IDs come from Omada's internet basic-info surface. Leave empty only when intentionally using another WAN selector.

### Read-Only

- `port_forwarding_id` (String) Port-forwarding rule ID assigned by the controller.
